notes.title: The Demo is reopened and the content description is updated
notes.content: [p][b]Mooncorona - Version 9.4 Test Build Update Notes[/b][/p][p]Hello everyone! After a brief period of development and debugging, the new version of [i]Mooncorona[/i] is now officially live![/p][p]This update not only addresses various issues encountered in the game but also introduces brand-new challenges and systems, aiming to add more fun and surprises to your exploration journey. Thank you for your patience and support—it is your valuable feedback that has helped make the world of [i]Mooncorona[/i] more complete.[/p][p]To make the gameplay of [i]Mooncorona[/i] more challenging and thrilling, we have implemented several new systems:[/p][p]· [b]Added \[Death Penalty Mechanism][/b]: To encourage players to think more strategically about survival, dying will now result in the loss of some Echoes. But don't worry—you can retrieve lost Echoes by returning to the location of your death. This makes every adventure more strategic and your choices more deliberate.[/p][p]· [b]Added \[Echo Items][/b]: You can now use Echo items collected during exploration to perform [b]\[Echo Extraction][/b] at crystals, permanently enhancing your base attributes or obtaining additional Echoes.[/p][p]· [b]Added \[Shadow Creature Growth System][/b]: Your first encounter with [b]\[Shadow Encroachment][/b] will no immediately overwhelm you. However, as you continue to explore and defeat Shadow Creatures, their strength will gradually increase. In the future, their drops can also be exchanged for special cards and weapons.[/p][p]Defeating the training dummy in Moonseek might be too time-consuming for new players, so we've added a [b]\[Combat Exit][/b] function to dummy battles, allowing you to end fights early.[/p][p]We've deeply listened to player feedback and made detailed optimizations and adjustments to multiple aspects of the game. Whether you're new to [i]Mooncorona[/i] or a seasoned veteran, you'll experience smoother and more immersive gameplay:[/p][p]· [b]Major Improvements to New Player Experience[/b]: We've redesigned the early-game tutorial flow. From your first dialogue with Amaris to job changes and deck building, everything is now presented in a more story-driven and engaging way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515176/af81231c20cd323a594e2079ba24a72210f95897.gif"][/img][/p][p]· [b]Map Exploration Updates and Adjustments[/b]: We've fine-tuned multiple maps, including the [b]Lost Church[/b], [b]Kormaila Forest[/b], and [b]Demosteel Fortress[/b], adjusting monster distribution, item drops, and scene layouts to make exploration more balanced and rewarding. Additionally, we've opened [b]King's Avenue[/b] at the fortress's main gate and the mining town of [b]Anwo[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515176/70ae19367ab08c3ad368a579e70d2051652d4546.png"][/img][/p][p]· [b]Combat and Character Experience Optimizations[/b]: We've adjusted cards, weapons, stats, and monsters for certain characters, and optimized numerous visual and sound effects to enhance the impact and strategic depth of battles.[/p][p][b]\[Optimizations & Adjustments][/b][/p][p]· Optimized overall level design in [b]\[Lost Church][/b]: Increased item drops, enhanced guidance, and reduced enemy density[/p][p]· Improved scene configuration and loading strategies for [b]\[Kormaila Forest][/b], [b]\[Demosteel Fortress][/b], and [b]\[Anwo][/b] maps[/p][p]· Streamlined initial dialogue guidance with [b]\[Amaris][/b][/p][p]· Revamped job change process to be presented through interactive storytelling[/p][p]· Enhanced early-game guidance for deck building, equipment swapping, and job advancement[/p][p]· Refined descriptive text for [b]\[Job Classes][/b], [b]\[Advancement Materials][/b], [b]\[Weapons][/b], and [b]\[Equipment][/b][/p][p]· Improved overall localization quality for [b]\[EN][/b] and [b]\[JP][/b] language versions[/p][p]· Upgraded UI presentation in menu interfaces[/p][p]· Enhanced UI visuals in job selection screen[/p][p]· Optimized [b]\[Mark Slots][/b] UI in preparation interface[/p][p]· Refined note content in specific scenes[/p][p]· Adjusted NPC and enemy collision boxes/positioning in certain areas[/p][p]· Improved BGM and interaction SFX in select scenes[/p][p]· Enhanced tooltip text for item interactions in specific environments[/p][p]· Adjusted item placement in various scenes[/p][p]· Improved card description formatting and visual layout[/p][p]· Enhanced VFX for specific cards and weapons[/p][p]· Upgraded SFX for certain cards and weapons[/p][p]· Improved battle entry notification text presentation[/p][p]· Optimized buff effect notifications during combat[/p][p]· Enhanced VFX for specific enemies in battles[/p][p]· Relocated crystal in [b]\[Moonseek][/b]: Now requires manual activation at the first time[/p][p]· Adjusted crystal positions in [b]\[Demosteel Fortress][/b] map[/p][p]· Modified enemy stats and placement in certain scenes[/p][p]· Rebalanced deck size for some job classes[/p][p]· Adjusted numerical values and attributes for specific weapons[/p][p]· Tweaked stats for certain items[/p][p]· Modified attack range for select enemies[/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p]· Fixed non-functional settings options in main menu[/p][p]· Resolved unresponsive confirmation button in settings interface[/p][p]· Addressed volume adjustment failure in settings menu[/p][p]· Fixed duplicate display of tutorial prompts[/p][p]· Corrected abnormal job description display in job selection screen[/p][p]· Resolved equipment interface and character model refresh issues[/p][p]· Fixed EXP numerical display errors in level-up interface[/p][p]· Repaired text display abnormalities in [b]\[Inspiration Slots][/b] interface[/p][p]· Corrected icon display issues in Teleport interface[/p][p]· Fixed display errors during loading screens[/p][p]· Resolved weapon display glitches when entering combat passively[/p][p]· Repaired character animation mismatches when using specific cards in combat[/p][p]· Fixed incorrect cost and effect configurations for certain cards[/p][p]· Corrected discrepancies between actual effects and descriptions for some cards[/p][p]· Resolved tooltip display issues for weapons and card effects in combat[/p][p]· Fixed buff icon and description display abnormalities[/p][p]· Addressed abnormal triggering of hidden enemies during combat[/p][p]· Repared battle exit malfunction[/p][p]· Fixed duplicate enemy display after combat concludes[/p][p]· Corrected scene display abnormalities post-combat[/p][p]· Resolved issue with certain bosses respawning after crystal interaction[/p][p]· Fixed discrepancy between actual effect and description for [b]\[Red Crystal Fruit Incense][/b][/p][p]· Repaired abnormal consumption issue for stat reset item [b]\[Vision of the Crescent Moon][/b][/p][p]· Fixed default state and interaction abnormalities for items in certain scenes[/p][p]· Corrected default state issues for crystals in specific areas[/p]
